<div class="card-body">
'''Vader's Custom TIE''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを１名乗せることができる。パイロットがベイダーなら、専用タイは耐：損耗＜４を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-306o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タイ・アドバンストｘ１の試作限定生産の初号機。後継機タイ・インターセプター開発の基礎となった。ベイダーの要請に応え、ハイパードライブが組み込まれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Vader's Personal TIE Fighter.

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot. If Vader is the pilot, this TIE is immune to attrition less than 4. Without a pilot, it cannot use its power, maneuver, or hyperspeed.

'''Lore:''' The first of a limited run of TIE Advanced x1 prototypes. It formed the basis for the later TIE Interceptor. A hyperdrive was installed at Vader's request.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Custom TIE]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
